meaning:
1) to interweave
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to interweave
1a2) interwoven (participle)
1b) (Pual) to be interwoven

renderings.kjv: For while they be folden together

elsewhere.note: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.
For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
